scene.title: Constructing a Perpendicular Bisector
scene.summary: Build the perpendicular bisector of a segment using its midpoint.

beats.title: Draw segment AB
beats.narration: We start with segment AB and its endpoints A and B.

beats.title: Find midpoint M
beats.narration: The midpoint M is exactly halfway between A and B.

check.question: Which line should be drawn through M to bisect AB?
check.explain: The perpendicular line through the midpoint bisects the segment.

beats.title: Draw perpendicular bisector
beats.narration: Through M we draw a line perpendicular to AB; this is the perpendicular bisector.

beats.title: Result
beats.narration: The line through M is the perpendicular bisector, giving equal distances to A and B for any point on it.
